capabilities: Export all Apple Books highlights and annotations into the vault
Search and export a single book by name or author
Look up book info on Goodreads and insert it at the cursor
extras: macOS-only: the plugin reads Apple Books' local SQLite3 database and needs permission for Obsidian to access Mac data (issue #63). Templating uses handlebars-helpers and handlebars-group-by; template parameters are documented in docs/parameters.md.
problem: Highlights and annotations made in Apple Books stay locked in a local SQLite database with no built-in way to get them into Obsidian notes.
summary: Export tool that copies Apple Books (macOS iBook) highlights and annotations from the local SQLite database into vault notes.
